Text A. If the weather is dry, our group will walk across the field with a teacher at ten. We will look at trees and small plants. If the field is wet, we will draw the same plants from photographs in the hall.

Text B. We will take photographs near the lake if the teacher says the weather is suitable. The group meets at eleven. Cloud alone will not stop us. If there is heavy rain, we will learn to choose and label pictures indoors.

Text C. Our activity will happen indoors in all weather. We will compare leaves and read a guidebook at twelve. If you bring a leaf from your garden, we will add it to our table. No outdoor walk is planned.
